programme.title: Clerks

His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer).

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain.

programme.title: Nothing Compares
programme.desc: Following the career of singer Sinéad O'Connor through her rise to fame and how her iconoclastic personality led to her exile from the pop mainstream.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) becomes acting deputy director of the CIA when Admiral Greer (James Earl Jones) is diagnosed with cancer. When an American businessman, and friend of the president, is murdered on a yacht, Ryan starts discovering links between the man and drug dealers. As CIA agent John Clark (Willem Dafoe) is sent to Colombia to kill drug kingpins in retaliation, Ryan must fight through multiple cover-ups to figure out what happened and who's responsible.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: Insurance salesman Michael is on his daily commute home, which quickly becomes anything but routine. After being contacted by a mysterious stranger, Michael is forced to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop. As he works against the clock to solve the puzzle, he realizes a deadly plan is unfolding, and he is unwittingly caught up in a criminal conspiracy that carries life and death stakes for everyone on the train.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe).

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: Obsessed with bringing terrorist Castor Troy (Nicolas Cage) to justice, FBI agent Sean Archer (John Travolta) tracks down Troy, who has boarded a plane in Los Angeles. After the plane crashes and Troy is severely injured, possibly dead, Archer undergoes surgery to remove his face and replace it with Troy's. As Archer tries to use his disguise to elicit information about a bomb from Troy's brother, Troy awakes from a coma and forces the doctor who performed the surgery to give him Archer's face.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: U.S. Navy pilot Lt. Jake Grafton (Brad Johnson) and his bombardier buddy, Lt. Cmdr. Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October

The monastery is home to a host of orphans whom Nacho cares for deeply, but there is not much money to feed them properly. Nacho decides to raise money for the children by moonlighting as a Lucha Libre wrestler with his partner Esqueleto (Héctor Jiménez), but since the church forbids Lucha, Nacho must disguise his identity.

This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive.

programme.desc: A smart high-school student with his heart set on going to Stanford is horrified when his guidance counselor accidentally sends the wrong transcript with his college application. He spends the rest of the film trying to prove that he's actually a good student with a terrific grade-point average.

programme.title: Irena's Vow
programme.desc: Caught in a German roundup to be used as a slave laborer, Polish nurse Irena Gut becomes a German army major's housekeeper during World War II. Irena risks her life to conceal a dozen Jews within the major's home.

programme.title: Carriers
programme.desc: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe.

programme.title: The Kings of Summer
programme.desc: Three teenagers (Nick Robinson, Gabriel Basso, Moises Arias) carry out a plan to leave their dysfunctional parents, build a house in the woods and live off the land.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers.

programme.title: Mean Creek

When Rocky (Trevor Morgan), Sam's elder brother, finds out Sam is being picked on, he enlists his buddies to help get back at George. They ask George to accompany them on a boating expedition deep in the woods, but when their plan to humiliate George horrifically backfires, the friends make a series of poor decisions that will change their lives.

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay.

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond is a New York City money launderer who wakes up with no memory and millions of dollars in stolen cash and drugs. He must soon scour the streets in search of answers while trying to dodge a crew of violent and crooked cops.

programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: Here and Now
programme.desc: After receiving a grim diagnosis, a successful New York singer spends the day reflecting on her life. She crisscrosses the city as she attempts to make peace with her friends, family and failures.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree.

programme.title: Anthropoid
programme.desc: In December 1941, two Czech soldiers (Cillian Murphy, Jamie Dornan) parachute into their occupied homeland to assassinate Nazi officer Reinhard Heydrich (Detlef Bothe).

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis).

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: 4:44 Last Day on Earth
programme.desc: Two lovers (Willem Dafoe, Shanyn Leigh) immerse themselves in sex, art and other activities after word breaks that the world will end by the next morning.

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls."

programme.title: Young Adult
programme.desc: Mavis Gary (Charlize Theron) is a successful writer of teen literature who returns to her hometown with a dual mission: to relive her glory days and steal away her now-married high-school sweetheart (Patrick Wilson). However, her mission does not go exactly to plan, and she finds her homecoming more problematic than she expected. Instead, Mavis forms an unusual bond with a former classmate (Patton Oswalt), who has also found it difficult to move past high school.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert

Soon, the new resident falls for his compassionate foster sister, Cathy (Juliette Binoche). The two share a remarkable bond that seems unbreakable until Cathy, feeling the pressure of social convention, suppresses her feelings and marries Edgar Linton (Simon Shepherd), a man of means who befits her stature. Heathcliff vows to win her back.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: CFP First Round: Miami at Texas A&M The No. 7 Aggies host the No. 10 Hurricanes in the College Football Playoff's first round. Texas A&M saw its undefeated season, and its chance at the SEC title, spoiled in a Nov. 28 loss at Texas. These programs traded home wins in 2022 and 2023.

programme.title: CFP Quarterfinal at the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic
programme.desc: Miami vs. Ohio State The No. 10 Miami Hurricanes face the No. 2 Ohio State Buckeyes at AT&T Stadium. This is a high-stakes College Football Playoff Quarterfinal matchup. Miami advanced after a gritty 10-3 road upset over No. 7 Texas A&M in the CFP First Round.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Miami at Florida State The No. 3 Hurricanes visit the No. 18 Seminoles. Miami leads the rivalry series 36-33 after beating Florida State 36-14 in 2024. FSU is coming off a double-overtime loss to Virginia on Sept. 26. Miami last played Sept. 20, beating Florida 26-7.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: California at Virginia Tech The Golden Bears (5-2, 2-1 ACC) make their first trip to Lane Stadium to face the Hokies (2-5, 1-2). The only previous meeting between the schools came in the 2003 Insight Bowl, when Cal quarterback Aaron Rodgers led his side to a 52-49 shootout win.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Louisville at Miami The Cardinals (4-1, 1-1 ACC) try to bounce back against a tough foe in the No. 2 Hurricanes (5-0, 1-0). Louisville dropped its first game of the season in a 30-27 overtime decision versus Virginia on Oct. 4. Miami defeated Louisville 52-45 last year.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Tattletales
programme.desc: Tattletales is an American game show which first aired on the CBS daytime schedule on February 18, 1974. It was hosted by Bert Convy, with several announcers, including Jack Clark, Gene Wood, Johnny Olson and John Harlan, providing the voiceover at various times.The show's premise involved questions asked about celebrity couples' personal lives and was based on He Said, She Said, a syndicated Goodson-Todman show that aired during the 1969—1970 season.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: Tattletales
programme.desc: Tattletales is an American game show which first aired on the CBS daytime schedule on February 18, 1974. It was hosted by Bert Convy, with several announcers, including Jack Clark, Gene Wood, Johnny Olson and John Harlan, providing the voiceover at various times.The show's premise involved questions asked about celebrity couples' personal lives and was based on He Said, She Said, a syndicated Goodson-Todman show that aired during the 1969—1970 season.

programme.title: Concentration
programme.desc: One of NBC's longest-running programs, this seminal game show was a daytime staple from 1958 to '73, with forays into prime time in '58 and '61. Of all the emcees who revealed the rebus (Ed McMahon and Bob Clayton among them), Hugh Downs is the one best remembered. In 1987, the series was resurrected as `Classic Concentration,' with Alex Trebek as host until the show's end in 1994.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Mississippi State The No. 22 Longhorns head to Starkville, Miss., to play the Bulldogs. Texas has won five of its past six after outlasting Kentucky 16-13 in overtime Oct. 18. Entering Week 9, Texas' defense ranked third nationally, allowing only 11.3 points per game.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Vanderbilt at Texas The No. 9 Commodores (7-1, 3-1 SEC) visit the No. 20 Longhorns (6-2, 3-1). Texas defeated Vanderbilt 27-24 in 2024 in the first meeting since 1928. Vandy hung on for a 17-10 victory last week as a Hail Mary pass by Missouri came up one yard short.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas at Georgia The No. 5 Bulldogs host the No. 10 Longhorns. In 2024, Georgia beat Texas 30-15 in the regular season, and 22-19 in overtime in the SEC title game. Texas held off then-No. 9 Vanderbilt for a fourth straight win Nov. 1. Georgia has won five in a row.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Arkansas at Texas The No. 17 Longhorns (7-3, 4-2 SEC) battle the Razorbacks (2-8, 0-6). Texas picked up a 20-10 decision at Arkansas in 2024, but fell 35-10 at then-No. 5 Georgia on Nov. 15 to end a four-game winning run. The Razorbacks have dropped eight in a row.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas A&M at Texas The unbeaten No. 3 Aggies face the No. 16 Longhorns in a Lone Star Showdown tilt. Texas A&M finds itself in the driver's seat for both an SEC title-game appearance and College Football Playoff berth after starting 11-0 for the first time since 1992.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Cheez-It Citrus Bowl: Michigan vs. Texas Storied programs in the No. 13 Longhorns and the No. 18 Wolverines line up in the Citrus Bowl from Orlando, Fla. Both sides are 9-3. The schools meet for the third time after the Longhorns defeated the Wolverines 31-12 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Stanford at BYU The Cardinal clash with the Cougars from Provo, Utah. Stanford has been off since Aug. 23, when it lost its season opener 23-20 to Hawaii on a last-second field goal. BYU smoked Portland State 69-0 on Aug. 30. BYU took down Stanford 35-26 in 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at East Carolina The Cougars clash with the Pirates. East Carolina has outscored its opposition 94-3 during its two-game win streak. BYU is 2-0, outscoring foes 96-3. East Carolina stunned BYU 27-24 with a game-winning field goal as time expired on Oct. 28, 2022.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Colorado The No. 25 Cougars begin their Big 12 slate with a game against the Buffaloes at Folsom Field. With Kaidon Salter back at starting quarterback, Colorado dumped Wyoming 37-20 to improve to 2-2 on Sept. 20. BYU is 3-0 for the third straight season.

programme.title: Authentic ACC

programme.title: Authentic ACC
programme.desc: SMU Spring Football In this edition of the series produced by SMU Athletics, get an inside look at Spring Football for the 2025 SMU Mustangs.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Arizona The Cougars (5-0, 2-0 Big 12) try for their fifth straight victory over the Wildcats (4-1, 1-1). BYU is 5-0 for the fourth time in six years following a 38-24 win over West Virginia. Arizona quarterback Noah Fifita has accounted for 16 touchdowns.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: BYU at Texas Tech A clash of Big 12 elites sees the No. 8 Red Raiders (8-1, 5-1) host the No. 7 Cougars (8-0, 5-0). Both sides boast a ranked win over Utah this year, with Texas Tech prevailing 34-10 on the road Sept. 20 and BYU grinding out a 24-21 home win Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: TCU at BYU The No. 12 Cougars (8-1, 5-1 Big 12) try to bounce back when they host the Horned Frogs (6-3, 3-3). TCU has won five in a row over BYU after a 44-11 result in 2023 in their first meeting since 2011. BYU fell 29-7 at then-No. 8 Texas Tech on Nov. 8.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: UCF at BYU The No. 11 Cougars host the Knights in a regular-season finale. BYU is in the driver's seat for its first Big 12 title-game appearance after holding off Cincinnati in Week 13. LJ Martin ran for 101 yards and a touchdown to help BYU beat UCF in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Big 12 Championship: BYU vs. Texas Tech The No. 4 Red Raiders and No. 11 Cougars make their debuts in the Big 12 title game. Both teams are 11-1. Texas Tech beat BYU 29-7 in November. The Raiders held the Cougars to 67 rushing yards in that contest, well below their 194.5 season average.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Pop-Tarts Bowl: Georgia Tech vs. BYU The No. 12 Cougars and No. 22 Yellow Jackets clash in a high-stakes edition of the Pop-Tarts Bowl. BYU fell to Texas Tech in the Big 12 title game. Georgia Tech dropped three of its last four to fall out of CFP consideration and miss the ACC final.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Notre Dame at Miami The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Notre Dame at Arkansas The Razorbacks (2-2) face the No. 22 Fighting Irish (1-2). Arkansas dropped back-to-back road games to Ole Miss and Memphis after a 2-0 start at home. Jadarian Price found the end zone four times Sept. 20 in Notre Dame's 56-30 win over Purdue.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Notre Dame at Boston College The No. 12 Fighting Irish (5-2) vie for a sixth straight victory as they visit the Eagles (1-7). Notre Dame has won nine straight Holy War meetings. Fighting Irish junior Jeremiyah Love has rushed for 417 yards and four TDs in the last three games.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Notre Dame at Pittsburgh Surging 7-2 sides meet in the Steel City as the No. 9 Fighting Irish visit the No. 22 Panthers. Notre Dame boasts a seven-game win streak. Pittsburgh has won five in a row. The Fighting Irish won the last two engagements by a combined 103-10 score.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Notre Dame at Stanford The No. 9 Fighting Irish end their regular season by visiting the Cardinal. Notre Dame has won nine straight games, against teams with a combined 45-53 record entering Week 14, after scoring its most points since 1932 in a 70-7 win over Syracuse.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at Florida State The Seminoles put 2024 in the rearview during this opener against the No. 8 Crimson Tide. Florida State went a forgettable 2-10 last year. Alabama turns to Ty Simpson at quarterback after Jalen Milroe was drafted by the NFL's Seattle Seahawks.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Louisiana-Monroe at Alabama The No. 21 Crimson Tide limp home to face the Warhawks. Alabama had its streak of season-opening victories stopped at 23 games with a 31-17 setback at Florida State. Germie Bernard (ALA) registered a career-high 146 receiving yards in that contest.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Wisconsin at Alabama The No. 19 Crimson Tide (1-1) prepare for another test as they host the Badgers (2-0) in Week 3. Alabama got on the board with a 73-0 dismantling of Louisiana Monroe on Sept. 6. Bama rolled to a 42-10 verdict over Wisconsin on Sept. 14, 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at Georgia The No. 5 Bulldogs (3-0, 1-0 SEC) take on the No. 17 Crimson Tide (2-1, 0-0). Alabama has won both meetings since Georgia claimed the 2021 title over the Tide. Ryan Williams (ALA) posted 177 receiving yards in last year's 41-34 win.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Vanderbilt at Alabama The No. 16 Commodores (5-0, 1-0 SEC) vie for their first win streak against the No. 10 Crimson Tide (3-1, 1-0) since 1956. Vanderbilt snapped a 23-game series slide with a 40-35 victory in 2024. Alabama won at then-No. 5 Georgia 24-21 in Week 5.

programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at Missouri The No. 14 Tigers (5-0, 1-0 SEC) brace for the No. 8 Crimson Tide (4-1, 2-0). Alabama has won four in a row after prevailing 30-14 over Vanderbilt on Oct. 4, and is 5-0 versus Missouri since 2012. Mizzou is 5-0 for the second time in three years.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Tennessee at Alabama The No. 6 Crimson Tide seek a sixth straight win when they host the No. 11 Volunteers. Last season, Tennessee beat Alabama for the second time in its last 18 attempts, as Chris Brazzell II caught the go-ahead TD pass in a 24-17 decision.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at South Carolina The No. 4 Crimson Tide bring a full head of steam into this match with the Gamecocks. Alabama has won six in a row, with the past four victories coming over ranked opponents after a 37-20 verdict against then-No. 11 Tennessee on Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: LSU at Alabama The Tigers (5-3, 2-3 SEC) try to put a tumultuous period behind them as they visit the No. 4 Crimson Tide (7-1, 5-0). LSU dismissed head coach Brian Kelly and athletic director Scott Woodward in the days following a 49-25 loss to Texas A&M.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Oklahoma at Alabama The No. 11 Sooners (7-2, 3-2 SEC) visit the No. 4 Crimson Tide (8-1, 6-0) in this marquee matchup. Alabama has won eight straight after burying LSU, 20-9 out of its bye Nov. 8. Oklahoma shocked then-No. 14 Tennessee 33-27 before its week off Nov. 1.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Alabama at Auburn SEC rivals in the No. 10 Crimson Tide (9-2, 6-1) and Tigers (5-6, 1-6) meet in the Iron Bowl. Alabama leads the series 51-37-1. The Crimson Tide will earn a berth in the SEC championship game if they beat the Tigers for the sixth straight time.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Texas-San Antonio at Texas A&M The Roadrunners face the No. 19 Aggies at Kyle Field. UTSA won a postseason game for a second straight year in 2024, thrashing Coastal Carolina 44-15 in the Myrtle Beach Bowl. Texas A&M went 8-5 in its first year under the supervision of Mike Elko.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Utah State at Texas A&M No. 19 Texas A&M, led by sophomore quarterback Marcel Reed, welcomes Utah State to Kyle Field for an all-Aggies affair. Reed passed for 289 yards and a career-high four touchdowns in a 42-24 victory over UTSA in Week 1. Utah State topped UTEP 28-16.

Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Crispy Chicken Oven Hack Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Pantry Pasta and Rice Pudding Pops Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Freezer Friendly Favorites Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Shake Up Your Salads Jamie's dressing a salad with a crown of cheese! He's also got a speedy twist on Sunday roast chicken and an elegant apple tart all with 5 fabulous ingredients.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E15 — Pizzapalooza Chef Dale Talde is throwin' down a pizza spread like never before with his Chicago-style tavern pie with sausage & onion, a grilled pizza pocket with pepperoni & cheese, chicken wings a la pizzaiola, and a zesty grilled Caesar salad to finish it off.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Pizza-Town Dale reinvents pizza night: grilled pizza bagels loaded with pepperoni, mozzarella-stuffed penne vodka pie, a massive grilled chop salad, and olive oil cake with burnt orange caramel. Pizza goals achieved.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S03 E04 — Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E06 — Taco Like It's Hot Taco night, Dale-style! Puffy al pastor tacos stuffed with pineapple-chile pork, grilled chicken pipian with charred tomato sauce, crispy street corn ribs, and dulce de leche empanadas. Taco Tuesday who?

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E05 — World of Burgers! It's burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S05 E08 — Thanksgiving On The Grill Thanksgiving goes to the grill with Chef Dale-juicy spatchcock turkey, grilled sage-cornbread stuffing, smoked green bean casserole, and pumpkin donut bread pudding drenched in bourbon brown butter sauce.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill Anything is possible with a wok and a good ol' charcoal grill, at least if you're Chef Dale, who throws together a heavenly spread of fiery eats, from drunken meats, stir-fried veggies, and stir-fried noodles.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Yakitori and More-Y Don't sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it's Chef Dale night to cook! He's serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

programme.title: All Up In My Grill
programme.desc: S04 E04 — Caribbean Latin BBQ Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drink with a charred banana.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Venison and Duck Gumbo Chef Andrew Zimmern grills his favorite tender cuts of venison and serves it with coal-roasted sweet potatoes. Then, he cooks a hearty pot of classic Louisiana gumbo using wild duck and grills crispy-skinned duck breast for the topping.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Boar Ribs and Shrimp and Grits Chef Andrew Zimmern makes a homemade barbecue rub, basting sauce and barbecue sauce for wild boar ribs. Next, chef shares his twist on a classic southern shrimp and grits recipe, adding a side of beautiful wild mushrooms.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Roasted Goose and Striped Bass Chef Zimmern cooks his version of Peking-style goose. Next, Chef Zimmern cooks a meal of striped bass.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Go Burger or Go Home! Tonight is a trio of backyard burgers! We're making Oklahoma Smashed Onion Burgers, New York Steakhouse Burgers and Fries, and Bougie Castle-Inspired Sliders.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Better Than Delivery Pizza Night We're grilling our three favorite styles of pizza tonight: Chicago Tavern with Sausage and Hot Giardiniera, New York Ricotta and Hot Honey, and a spicy Detroit Pepperoni.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Midnight Sandwich Express It's sandwich night! We're making our favorite handheld late-night delights: Chicken Parm Hero, (Not a Philly) Cheesesteak, and Bodega Chopped Cheese. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Breakfast After Dark We're making our late-night breakfast for dinner standards with the Waffle House All-Star, Steak and Eggs, and a Fast Food Sausage Breakfast Sandwich.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Late Night Mexican Food Truck The Grill Dads bring late-night Mexican food truck eats to your backyard with pollo al pastor tacos, Mission-style carne asada burritos, and mini beef chimichangas.

programme.title: Grill'n After Dark
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner Tonight is all about chicken comfort-food dishes: a Gochujang Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich, Almost Buffalo Wings, and a Spicy Chicken Salad Wrap. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Carne Adovada Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S05 E05 — Super Squash Never underestimate the power of squash: they're affordable, abundant, and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Let's Play Ball No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S05 E08 — The Future is Flavor Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S05 E09 — Pantry Pasta It's no secret that pasta is Frankie's favorite; he's serving it up all night without even opening his fridge.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S05 E10 — Potato Variety Show Frankie's slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, a staple for any Struggle kitchen.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Eggscellent Techniques Frankie teaches several methods for cooking eggs; the scramble, the omelet, and the Benedict; learn to make them just the way one likes them.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Vintage Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they'll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E04 — Struggle Soup Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie's soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Struggle Sandwich In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin's, and Frankie's cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E06 — Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it's about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E07 — Mayo: The Secret Ingredient Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It's a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it's easy to make at home!

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crunchy Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

programme.desc: S04 E09 — A Cruciferous Delicious Time No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they've become a fixture in Frankie's meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S04 E10 — 5-Ingredient Recipes These five-ingredient recipes are anything but boring; with a few pantry staples, these simple weeknight meals will be on the table in no time.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E01 — Game Day Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. Game days aren't for dinner parties, but they are a day for some fan-favorite finger foods, especially those you can make in advance. Frankie makes three no-fuss appetizers.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Winter Is Here The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E03 — Valentine's Day Frankie prepares a Valentine's Day dinner for under $15 with a bistro-style theme to up the romance. Why go to a crowded restaurant for an overpriced prix-fixe menu with bad service when you can prepare a simple yet decadent romantic meal at home?

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E04 — Beans Beans Beans Dried beans are affordable and healthy to prepare. Frankie will teach the basics of preparing beans from scratch while making tasty recipes. We also take a field trip to the grocery store to shop the bulk aisle. They're also good for your heart.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E05 — Rent Week It's that time, the first of the month, when you spend your whole paycheck on rent and bills. Your fridge looks pretty sad and the grocery budget is low. Frankie cooks up some go-to pantry meals and also teaches us how to better prepare for this.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E06 — Mushroom Mania Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They're packed with nutritional value, and they're an affordable plant-based meat replacement. We'll learn about all things mushrooms and how to make some inventive, flavorful dishes.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E07 — No Kitchen No Problem Just because you're dorm living, road tripping, motel living, or haven't gotten that bachelor pad in shape yet, doesn't mean you can't make tasty meals from some handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E08 — Spring Fling Spring is in the air which means a whole new world opens up in the produce department, especially all the greens. Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It's tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E09 — Spice Is Nice Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. You know that area in your pantry that collects dust? Well get ready to dust it off. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends.

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: S03 E10 — Root-to-Stem Frankie teaches us how to use whole vegetables, from root-to-stem, which means no food goes to waste. Learn how to use those leafy green tops you thought were for decoration. Or vegetable stalks you would normally throw away.
